gate0.action: Confirm where in the lifecycle the deal is entering

hvReframe.horizontal: spans the entire deal lifecycle (workflow engine, compliance checker, spell check)
hvReframe.vertical: happens at a specific step (valuation, pitch deck, advocacy deck)
hvReframe.hybrid: some verticals built by the horizontal team (e.g. deal onboarding routing)

skipRule.rule: any step can be skipped with human approval; reason for skip routes to the appropriate next step

editRule.rule: editing completed steps always allowed — updates that step's output, does not revert the flow; outputs stored versioned (Pitch Valuation V1/V2, Advocacy Valuation V1/V2)

assignmentRule.rule: each step can be skipped or assigned to a human or an agent, and needs a deadline or priority tag

mvp.storm: all 82 steps present, human marks done/not-done, advances linearly — no skills, no agents
mvp.lance: 16 core steps across all five phases, origination through close
mvp.agreed: full step timeline in place, limited automation added progressively

stepAnatomy.rule: each step can: run a skill/agent, track token usage, require approval, be marked complete; step-level compliance tracking and audit trail

views.rule: two views: Focus (current step) and Full Array (all steps)

teams.futureproofing: horizontal layer, workflow engine, orchestration, audit/tracking
teams.rts: vertical agents and skills at each step (Markus, Svetozar)
teams.ignatious: process expertise, step descriptions, prioritization input
teams.process: each vertical step gets a dedicated 5-page spec doc assigned to a banker + RTS team member; integration/testing require step-lock between Futureproofing and RTS

ioFramework.rule: per component: input (what/format/source: API, file, etc.), transformation/process, expected output format, constraints/edge cases/guardrails for AI
